primary_outcomes: Turn 1: replies and starts attending to the person.
Turn 2: fetches the water; the attention is suspended during the fetch rather than ended.
Turn 3: a short reply; attention is on the person again.
acceptable_auxiliary: A brief, warm reply in the person's language.
forbidden_semantic_outcomes: The fetch ends or abandons the attention.

memberships.title: Everyday attention to the person
memberships.general_rule: While someone talks with Chromie she keeps her attention on them (the long-running social skill), lets body work take over and returns to them afterwards, and stops when they ask her not to look at them.
